_comment: BSC stable-stable pool registry for the stable-core study (built 2026-07-07). Same spirit as pool-fees/pools.json: HyperSync pulls = swaps/volume/liquidity per pool. All tokens verified 18 decimals on BSC (incl USDT/USDC — NOT 6 like mainnet). usd_token semantics n/a here (both legs USD): volume leg = token0 unless noted. tvl_usd + vol24h_usd = GeckoTerminal/DefiLlama/dexscreener snapshot 2026-07-07 (indicative only; verify from tape). swaps_14d = HyperSync Swap-log count last 2,688,000 blocks (14d @0.45s); singleton pools carry swaps_3d (576,000-block sweep) instead. Families univ4/pcs-infinity-cl are singletons: address = PoolManager, filter Swap logs by topic1 = pool_id.

block_range.block_time_note: empirical: (ts(107631883)-ts(107516683))/115200 = 0.4504s at head; window avg (head-6mo) = (1783443513-1767675964)/(108632883-74231575) = 0.4583s. BSC is sub-0.5s (post-Maxwell 0.75s halved again by 2026 upgrade) — NOT 0.75s; size pulls accordingly (~34.4M blocks / 6mo).

univ3.note: Uniswap v3 + Algebra (THENA fusion) + Topaz. data: amount0 int256, amount1 int256, sqrtPriceX96, liquidity, tick

pcsv3.note: PancakeSwap v3. Same first-5-word layout as univ3, +protocolFees words

univ4.note: Uniswap v4 PoolManager singleton; topic1 = poolId; data: amount0 int128, amount1 int128 (each in a full word), sqrtPriceX96, liquidity, tick, fee. NB v4 amounts are signed FROM THE SWAPPER'S perspective (negative = into pool) BSC PoolManager=0x28e2ea090877bf75740558f6bfb36a5ffee9e9df, PositionManager(poolKeys)=0x7A4a5c919aE2541AeD11041A1AEeE68f1287f95B.

pcs-infinity-cl.note: PancakeSwap Infinity CLPoolManager singleton; topic1 = poolId; +protocolFee word BSC CLPoolManager=0xa0ffb9c1ce1fe56963b0321b32e7a0302114058b (poolIdToPoolKey).

pcs-stable.note: PancakeSwap StableSwap (Ellipsis-lineage, uint256 coin ids). buyer indexed; data: sold_id, tokens_sold, bought_id, tokens_bought. fee=1bp admin 50%.

solidly.note: UniswapV2-layout event shared by PCS v2, THENA solidly pairs AND Nomiswap-stable (amount0In, amount1In, amount0Out, amount1Out; sender+to indexed)

wombat.note: Wombat Pool (multi-asset): sender indexed, data: fromToken, toToken, fromAmount, toAmount; to indexed

dodo.note: DODO DVM/DSP/DPP: data: fromToken, toToken, fromAmount, toAmount, trader, receiver
